Minecraft 26.3 Fabric preview with improved font loading and Storage ESP frame efficiency. Includes the previous startup and Fracture shader fixes and optional Visible Hitbox aiming for KillAura.

Replace the previous client33 JAR in your mods folder. Do not install both versions.

Requires Java 25, Minecraft 26.3 and Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or later. Bobby, Fabric API and Strata are bundled; no separate installation of those mods is required. Sodium and Baritone are optional.

The full Gradle build, font and storage regressions, and packaged-library checks passed. This exact JAR reached the title screen and opened the GUI in an isolated Fabric client. The earlier hotfix was tested on a local world and was confirmed by the user to work in game. Real-world FPS gains, live-server combat, image/outline shaders and this specific build on Windows remain unverified.

This build fixes the previous startup crash by including Javassist and other required runtime libraries in the Fabric JAR. Replace the previous client33 JAR in your mods folder; do not install both versions.

It also fixes the full-screen Fracture mask and adds KillAura's optional Visible Hitbox aiming and an Only On Look recheck.

Requires Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer, and Java 25. The packaged JAR started in an isolated Fabric client, opened the GUI and rendered Fracture on cows in a local world. The full build and regressions passed. Windows/NVIDIA, live server combat, 300-chunk performance, and image/outline shaders have not been verified in this run.

Minecraft 26.3 Fabric preview build with Storage ESP improvements, Bobby cached storage integration, and the Strata/Skia workspace.

Requires Java 25 and Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer. Bobby, Fabric API, and Strata are included in the JAR.

The build and module regressions passed. Storage ESP was checked in a local development world. The packaged JAR has not been tested in a production launcher. Actual 300-chunk performance and live server behavior are unverified.

Known issue: Fracture chams can cover the entire screen when an entity is selected.
